answer: Each agent identity must lock a stake of 500 cedar for 12 epochs before it can sign transactions or claim nectar. Forging N identities locks 500N cedar, and any proven sybil forfeits the full stake plus a 20 percent shared penalty applied across the operator's linked keys. Splitting or copying identities raises marginal cost per fake key, since independent jurors trace the shared comet penalized on every duplicate.
